question: Four consecutive page numbers in a book add up to 346. What is the smallest page number?

A delivery van carries 9 boxes. Each box contains 8 packets, and each packet contains 6 markers. If
27 markers are given away, how many markers remain?

Two parcels have a total mass of 8 kg 450 g. The heavier parcel is 1 kg 250 g heavier than the lighter
parcel. If 750 g is removed from the heavier parcel, what is its new mass?

A square and a rectangle have the same perimeter. The square has side 14 cm. The rectangle is 18
cm long. What is the breadth of the rectangle?

A train journey takes 2 h 45 min. The train arrives at 12.20 a.m. on Tuesday. At what time did it leave
on Monday?

Nora bought 4 identical notebooks and 1 pen. The pen cost $6. She paid with a $50 note and received
$8 change. How much did each notebook cost?

A box contains red, blue and green counters. 2/7 of the counters are red and 3/7 are blue. There are
12 more blue counters than red counters. How many green counters are there?
A rectangle is 5 cm longer than it is wide. Its perimeter is 54 cm. What is its length?
Study the pattern: 640, 611, 579, 544, 506, ____. What is the missing number?

Cards are arranged repeatedly in this pattern: A, B, C, D, D, C, B, A. The pattern continues in the same
way. How many B cards are there among the first 123 cards?

There are 28 children. 16 chose milk, 15 chose juice and 6 chose both. How many chose exactly one
of the two drinks?

Maya had 96 more stickers than Noah. They each gave away 18 stickers. After that, Maya had 4 times
as many stickers as Noah. How many stickers did Maya have at first?
